structures.name: Ventromedian Fissure
structures.about: The midline groove running along the ventral surface of the medulla, separating the left and right pyramidal tracts.

structures.name: Pyramidal Tract
structures.about: The paired bundles of descending motor fibers flanking the ventromedian fissure on the medulla, carrying cortical commands toward the spinal cord.

structures.name: Trapezoid Body
structures.about: The transverse band of auditory fibers crossing the ventral brainstem just caudal to the pons.

structures.name: Infundibulum
structures.about: The stalk connecting the hypothalamus to the pituitary gland. The pituitary itself is usually lost when the brain is removed from the skull.

structures.name: Optic Tract
structures.about: The band of visual fibers running caudolaterally from the optic chiasm toward the thalamus.

structures.name: Optic Chiasm
structures.about: The X-shaped crossing of the optic nerves on the ventral surface, where fibers from the nasal retina cross to the opposite side.

structures.name: Lateral Olfactory Tract
structures.about: The lateral branch carrying axons from the olfactory bulb back toward the rhinencephalon.

structures.name: Medial Olfactory Tract
structures.about: The medial branch carrying axons from the olfactory bulb toward the septal and medial olfactory areas.

structures.name: Olfactory Bulb
structures.about: The paired swelling at the rostral tip of the brain that receives axons from the olfactory epithelium. It is strikingly large in sheep.

structures.name: Medulla
structures.about: The most caudal part of the brainstem, continuous with the spinal cord. It houses centers for breathing, heart rate, and other vital reflexes.

structures.name: Pons
structures.about: The bulge on the ventral brainstem between the midbrain and the medulla. Its transverse fibers carry cortical information to the cerebellum.

structures.name: Interpeduncular Cistern
structures.about: The cerebrospinal fluid space in the hollow between the two cerebral peduncles.

structures.name: Cerebral Peduncles
structures.about: The paired columns of descending fibers on the ventral midbrain, carrying motor output from the cerebrum toward the brainstem and cord.

structures.name: Mammillary Bodies
structures.about: The paired rounded swellings on the ventral hypothalamus, caudal to the infundibulum. They relay hippocampal output through the fornix.

structures.name: Rhinal Fissure
structures.about: The groove along the ventrolateral surface separating the rhinencephalon from the neocortex.

structures.name: Rhinencephalon
structures.about: The olfactory brain: the ventrolateral cortex ventral to the rhinal fissure, prominent in sheep and other macrosmatic animals.
